race.comment: FULL CONFIDENCE (6) is a well bred filly by I Am Invincible out of G1 SA Derby winner Qafila who debuts for the McEvoy yard. She looked very smart winning a recent jumpout and sets up nicely. Should take beating. REGAL AMBITION (8) resumes having run on strongly from a tricky spot on debut at Ballarat, sent out favourite there. Can improve this time in and that experience is worth plenty. STIPULATION (9) tackled a good race on debut at Sandown Lakeside and worked home well for fourth. Better for that, just wonder if she wants more ground now. ACE STRIKE (1) is an Ace High gelding for the Price & Kent Jnr yard on debut. Shinn booked, wary from the inside gate. DISPATCHES (3) is a Gun Runner colt who can also run well.
